note: Phase 3 onward only. Phase 1 and Phase 2 analyst time was never measured and is reported as NOT_MEASURED rather than estimated.
why_not_measured: The instrument was BUILT during Phase 3, after the Sandlock diligence and the experiment analysis were already under way. Timing those sessions retroactively would be an estimate presented as a measurement, which is exactly what this project refuses to do. Phase 3's own analyst time is therefore reported as NOT_MEASURED, the same way Phase 1 and Phase 2 were.
